author: ULTIMATE7FALCON
body:
Woops, I managed to archive my first post as I posted it ggwp on my part......Take 2 xD

Hi I'm ULTIMATE7FALCON but most people just call me Falcon. I'm 17 years old and I have been played competitive Minecraft for almost 2 years now. I have played in multiple Race For Wool tournaments as well as played a ton on the Overcast Network with Eclipse. I recently found Avicus, and I have been enjoying it greatly. If you have any tips/advice I'm open to anything. Thanks :)
